methods.text: hasBusyRuntime(runtime: RuntimeKind): boolean { return [...this.sessions.values()].some((entry) => entry.runtime === runtime && entry.busy); }

methods.name: hasStaleProfile
methods.text: hasStaleProfile(runtime: RuntimeKind): boolean { return [...this.sessions.values()].some((entry) => entry.runtime === runtime && entry.profileRevision !== this.profileRevision(runtime)); }
